cvEn:
Hana Levi, daughter of Rachel and Masud, was born on 1 Shvat 5718 (22 January 1958) in Kiryat Malakhi. She attended the Shapira elementary school in Kiryat Malakhi and continued her secondary education at the agricultural boarding school at Mikveh Israel, in the agriculture and biology track.

Hana enlisted in the IDF in August 1976. After basic training she was assigned to the Air Force. Her commanders and fellow unit members appreciated her devoted and professional work, and above all her warmth and friendship.

On 11 Tammuz 5737 (27 June 1977), Hana fell during her military service. She was laid to rest in the cemetery in Kfar Vradim. She is survived by her parents and nine brothers and sisters.
